description: Line revenue after discount (gross amount minus discount), counted on the sale date at the selling store.
Quantity x unit price, before discount.
Discount given on sales lines.
Refunds, counted on the return date at the returning store (BRD assumption 2). Returns, stock and targets have no promotion key, so it is blank when the Promotion table is filtered.
dax: IF ( ISCROSSFILTERED ( Promotion ), BLANK (), SUM ( Returns[refund_value] ) )

description: Governed headline KPI (BRD 5.1): Sales Revenue minus Returns Value. Returns, stock and targets have no promotion key, so it is blank when the Promotion table is filtered.
dax: IF ( ISCROSSFILTERED ( Promotion ), BLANK (), [Sales Revenue] - [Returns Value] )

description: Net Revenue for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align). Drives every YoY comparison.
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Net Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Net Revenue change against the same period one year earlier.
Net Revenue growth against the same period one year earlier. Blank when the prior year is blank.
dax: DIVIDE ( [Net Revenue] - [Net Revenue PY], [Net Revenue PY] )

description: Sales Revenue for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Sales Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Quantity x standard unit cost on the sale date.
Cost credited back for returned units that go back to stock. Returns, stock and targets have no promotion key, so it is blank when the Promotion table is filtered.
dax: IF ( ISCROSSFILTERED ( Promotion ), BLANK (), SUM ( Returns[restock_cost_credit] ) )

description: Cost of goods sold net of returned-to-stock units (governed definition). Returns, stock and targets have no promotion key, so it is blank when the Promotion table is filtered.
dax: IF ( ISCROSSFILTERED ( Promotion ), BLANK (), [Cost of Sales] - [Restock Cost Credit] )
depends_on_measures: Cost of Sales, Restock Cost Credit

description: Net Revenue minus COGS (governed definition).
Gross Margin as a share of Net Revenue; ratio of sums, never an average of ratios.
Gross Margin for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Gross Margin], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Gross Margin change against the same period one year earlier.
Gross Margin % for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Gross Margin %], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Change in Gross Margin % in percentage points.
Receipts. With a product or category filter this is 'transactions containing the selection' (not additive across categories).
Transactions for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Transactions], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Transactions change against the same period one year earlier.
Transactions growth against the same period one year earlier. Blank when the prior year is blank.
Units sold.
Units for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Units], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Units growth year on year.
Units per transaction.
UPT for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [UPT], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Average selling price per unit.
ASP for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [ASP], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Sales Revenue per receipt (the governed AOV). Undefined for category filters (use ASP).
Average Transaction Value for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Average Transaction Value], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Stores with sales in the selection.
Receipts per trading store; compares store groups of different sizes.
Year-on-year change in receipts per trading store.
dax: VAR _cy = [Transactions per Store] VAR _py = CALCULATE ( [Transactions per Store], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ), 'Date'[date_key] ) ) RETURN DIVIDE ( _cy - _py, _py )

description: Units returned (return date). Returns, stock and targets have no promotion key, so it is blank when the Promotion table is filtered.
dax: IF ( ISCROSSFILTERED ( Promotion ), BLANK (), SUM ( Returns[return_quantity] ) )

description: Returns Value for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Returns Value], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Returns Value change against the same period one year earlier.
Returns Value growth against the same period one year earlier. Blank when the prior year is blank.
dax: DIVIDE ( [Returns Value] - [Returns Value PY], [Returns Value PY] )

description: Returns Value as a share of Sales Revenue in the same period (governed return rate, value basis).
Return Rate for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Return Rate], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Change in Return Rate in percentage points.
Refunds placed on the ORIGINAL sale date (sale cohort view); uses the inactive relationship.
Returned units placed on the original sale date.
Returned units per 100 units sold, both on the sale date: the cohort rate used in Phase 6.
Weekly stock snapshots of ranged store-SKUs. Returns, stock and targets have no promotion key, so it is blank when the Promotion table is filtered.
dax: IF ( ISCROSSFILTERED ( Promotion ), BLANK (), COUNTROWS ( Inventory ) )

description: Snapshots with closing stock above zero. Returns, stock and targets have no promotion key, so it is blank when the Promotion table is filtered.
dax: IF ( ISCROSSFILTERED ( Promotion ), BLANK (), SUM ( Inventory[is_in_stock] ) )

description: Stock Availability % (BRD 5.3): share of ranged store-SKU-weeks in stock at the weekly snapshot.
Availability for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Availability], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Change in Availability in percentage points.
Store-SKU-weeks with no opening stock, nothing received and out of stock at the snapshot (Phase 5/6 definition).
dax: IF ( ISCROSSFILTERED ( Promotion ), BLANK (), SUM ( Inventory[is_full_week_stockout] ) )

description: Full-Week Stock-Outs for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Full-Week Stock-Outs], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Sales Revenue on promoted lines.
Promoted share of Sales Revenue (governed promo revenue share).
Promotion Share for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Promotion Share], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Discount as a share of gross sales (the Phase 6 discount-rate definition).
Discount Rate for the same days one year earlier (364 days, so retail weeks align).
dax: VAR _pyDates = VALUES ( 'Date'[same_day_last_year_key] ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Discount Rate], REMOVEFILTERS ( 'Date' ), TREATAS ( _pyDates, 'Date'[date_key] ) )

description: Finance weekly Net Revenue target for the retail weeks in the selection (a partial week selection returns the whole week's target). Targets are set per store only, so the measure is blank under a product or promotion filter.
dax: IF ( ISCROSSFILTERED ( Product ) || ISCROSSFILTERED ( Promotion ), BLANK (), CALCULATE ( SUM ( Targets[target_net_revenue] ), TREATAS ( VALUES ( 'Date'[retail_week_key] ), Targets[retail_week_key] ) ) )

description: Net Revenue over the store-weeks that have a Finance target (weeks without a target are excluded from Target Achievement, as in Phase 5). Blank under a product or promotion filter.
dax: IF ( ISCROSSFILTERED ( Product ) || ISCROSSFILTERED ( Promotion ), BLANK (), VAR _pairs = CALCULATETABLE ( SUMMARIZE ( Targets, Targets[store_key], Targets[retail_week_key] ), TREATAS ( VALUES ( 'Date'[retail_week_key] ), Targets[retail_week_key] ) ) RETURN SUMX ( _pairs, VAR _s = Targets[store_key] VAR _w = Targets[retail_week_key] RETURN CALCULATE ( [Net Revenue], Store[store_key] = _s, 'Date'[retail_week_key] = _w ) ) )

description: Net Revenue as a share of target over store-weeks with a target (BRD 5.4; Phase 5 definition).
depends_on_measures: Net Revenue (Target Weeks), Target Net Revenue

description: Net Revenue minus target, over store-weeks with a target.
depends_on_measures: Net Revenue (Target Weeks), Target Net Revenue

description: Exclusive attribution of the H2 net revenue change (Phase 6). Not affected by slicers.
Share of the H2 net revenue change (Phase 6).
Sum of all attribution components; equals the H2 change exactly.
Impact of ONE driver (Phase 6). Blank at total level: the rows overlap (D02 repeats D01, D04 is part of D03, D06 repeats D05) and must never be added.
Size of the slice an investigation would explain. Blank at total level (slices overlap).
BRD evidence level of the selected driver (Phase 6).
Colour for conditional formatting; always shown together with the text label.
Colour of an attribution bar by evidence level (residual in light grey).
dax: VAR _lvl = SELECTEDVALUE ( p6_driver_attribution[evidence_level] ) RETURN SWITCH ( _lvl, "Root-cause evidence", "#1BAF7A", "Observed change", "#2A78D6", "Statistical association", "#EDA100", "Hypothesis", "#8F8D87", "#C9C7C1" )

description: Store-cluster excess decline vs matched control stores (Phase 6 ESTIMATE).
Increase in Electronics sales lost in full-week stock-outs (Phase 6 ESTIMATE).

measure: Lost Sales Net of Deferred Demand (P6)
description: Lost sales after netting off demand that returned after restock (Phase 6 ESTIMATE).
Low end of the stock-out sensitivity range (Phase 6).
High end of the stock-out sensitivity range (Phase 6).
Increase in estimated full-week lost sales by SKU (Phase 6 ESTIMATE).
Share of the lost-sales increase on the top 10% SKUs by prior-year revenue (Phase 6).
dax: DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [SKU Lost Sales Change (P6)], REMOVEFILTERS ( p6_et_sku_stockouts ), p6_et_sku_stockouts[high_seller] = TRUE () ), CALCULATE ( [SKU Lost Sales Change (P6)], REMOVEFILTERS ( p6_et_sku_stockouts ) ) )

measure: Top SKU Share of Lost Sales (P6)
description: Share of the lost-sales increase on the single largest SKU (Phase 6).
dax: DIVIDE ( MAXX ( ALL ( p6_et_sku_stockouts ), p6_et_sku_stockouts[lost_primary_change] ), CALCULATE ( [SKU Lost Sales Change (P6)], REMOVEFILTERS ( p6_et_sku_stockouts ) ) )

measure: Top 3 SKU Share of Lost Sales (P6)
description: Share of the lost-sales increase on the three largest SKUs (Phase 6).
dax: DIVIDE ( SUMX ( TOPN ( 3, ALL ( p6_et_sku_stockouts ), p6_et_sku_stockouts[lost_primary_change], DESC ), p6_et_sku_stockouts[lost_primary_change] ), CALCULATE ( [SKU Lost Sales Change (P6)], REMOVEFILTERS ( p6_et_sku_stockouts ) ) )

description: Stock-out episodes (runs of consecutive out-of-stock weeks), by supplier and year (Phase 6 FACT).
Mean episode length in weeks; use with one supplier and one year selected (Phase 6 FACT).
Home & Kitchen promotion events analysed in Phase 6, by year (FACT).
Revenue shortfall after promotions against event baselines (Phase 6 ESTIMATE).
Effect of the Home & Kitchen promotion change by method (Phase 6). Never summed across methods.
Blank at total level, so the four methods are never combined into one number.
Period in the current filter context.
dax: VAR _p = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Date'[period_label] ) RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _p ), "Multiple periods selected", _p )

description: Dynamic headline for the selected period, e.g. 'Net revenue €10.189M to €9.457M (-€731k, -7.18%)'.
dax: "Net revenue " & FORMAT ( [Net Revenue PY] / 1000000, "€#,0.000" ) & "M to " & FORMAT ( [Net Revenue] / 1000000, "€#,0.000" ) & "M (" & FORMAT ( [Net Revenue YoY] / 1000, "+€#,0;-€#,0" ) & "k, " & FORMAT ( [Net Revenue YoY %], "+0.00%;-0.00%" ) & ")"
depends_on_measures: Net Revenue, Net Revenue PY, Net Revenue YoY, Net Revenue YoY %

description: Caption for every visual built on imported Phase 6 tables.
dax: "Validated Phase 6 result for H2 2025 vs H2 2024. Not affected by slicers."

description: Required callout on the store page (Phase 6: cause UNRESOLVED).
dax: "Cause not established from available internal data."

dax: "Stock-out concentration is associated with Voltix SKUs. Available data cannot determine whether the cause was supplier performance or Brightwater ordering/replenishment."

description: Fixed-context check value: must equal €9,457,457.05 (Phase 4, 5, 6).
Fixed-context check value: must equal €10,188,727.55.
Compares the imported Phase 6 attribution with the model's own H2 change.
dax: VAR _change = [QA Net Revenue H2 2025] - [QA Net Revenue H2 2024] VAR _attr = [Attribution Total] RETURN IF ( ABS ( _change - _attr ) < 0.01, "PASS: attribution = H2 change", "FAIL: attribution differs from H2 change by " & FORMAT ( _attr - _change, "€#,0.00" ) )
depends_on_measures: Attribution Total, QA Net Revenue H2 2024, QA Net Revenue H2 2025
